name: Jim Clyburn

current_role: U.S. representative from South Carolina; the leading voice in the first 2028 Democratic primary state
summary: Jim Clyburn has represented South Carolina in the House since 1993 and was the No. 3 House Democrat from 2007 to 2023. His endorsement of Joe Biden three days before the 2020 South Carolina primary is widely credited with reviving Biden's campaign. With South Carolina voting first in the 2028 Democratic calendar, he is described as the party's biggest kingmaker for the nomination.
